why.thinCover: They play two strikers: with no defensive midfielder, your centre-backs are two against two.
why.winMidfield: Their midfield has two in the middle: with three centrally you win midfield.
why.widthVsScreen: Out of possession their two defensive midfielders close the middle: width pays off.
why.possessionVsLowPress: They rarely press: your short passing game will have time.
why.directVsHighPress: They press a lot: your direct game goes over the press.
why.attackLeaky: Their defence concedes often: an attacking mentality makes the most of it.
why.concedesMore: Against this formation they concede a clear-cut chance every {{every}} min ({{minutes}} min observed), more often than usual.
why.concedesLess: Against this formation they concede a clear-cut chance only every {{every}} min ({{minutes}} min observed).

roles.help: Each cell shows the fit for the best {{phase}} role at that position. Pills: natural positions. Grey numbers: out of position (the game adds a familiarity penalty). Dashed circle: out of position but better than at his own, worth a try. Hover a cell to see the role.

how.keys: 70%: the role's key attributes, weighted by importance.
how.base: 20%: the position's basic attributes (for a centre-back: marking, tackling, heading, positioning…).
how.engine: 10%: "match engine" attributes (acceleration, pace, anticipation, decisions), useful everywhere outfield.
how.foot: Stronger foot: on a flank, −0.5 if the foot does not match (−1 if one-footed). Inverted roles want the foot opposite to the flank.

style.whichHelp: Each style's requirements compared with the profile of the 16 best available outfield players. Pick a style for details.
style.profileHelp: Average out of 20. Highlighted: what the selected style needs.
style.rolesHelp: Fit = weighted average of the role's key attributes. Injured players excluded.
style.effHelp: New in FM27: a gauge tells whether the team will carry out your instructions. FM Immersion estimates it here; the game's real gauges are under "Effectiveness" once the plugin reads them.
style.simplify: Simplify instructions or plan training time.
style.allClose: All styles are within {{gap}} of each other: your squad doesn't favour any. Pick your project's style; FM Immersion builds the best eleven for each.

why.large: More width to move the ball around and stretch the opponent. The game only offers this at the start of a season; the effect is a small bonus.
why.short: Less ground to cover when pressing and winning the ball back. The game only offers this at the start of a season; the effect is a small bonus.
why.long: Space behind the opponent for quick attacks. The game only offers this at the start of a season; the effect is a small bonus.
why.narrow: A tight game for second balls and early crosses. The game only offers this at the start of a season; the effect is a small bonus.
why.min: As little space as possible for the opponent against a low block. The game only offers this at the start of a season; the effect is a small bonus.
why.normal: No clear preference for this style: keep normal dimensions.

eff.none: The game's effectiveness gauges are not in this snapshot yet. Meanwhile, FM Immersion's estimate is under "Playing style".
eff.snapsSub: import every week to track progress

proj.tipRecruit_other: Signing speeds everything up: {{count}} more ready positions needed to reach 7 of 11.
proj.tipBridge: Bridge style: {{bridge}} is almost as suitable as {{rec}} and closer to your project.

proj.noRecruit: No position to sign at this target level.
proj.recruitAll: For all signings, the style needs: {{list}}.
proj.collectiveMore: Also: team cohesion for buy-in, match preparation for the opposition report.

pi.locks: Locks inferred from the roles (screening, covering, dropping, outlet: pressing locked to “Less often”; pressing roles: “More often”). If you spot another padlock in game, say so and the rule will be extended.
pi.nothing: Nothing to add: the role is enough.
pi.switch: Role {{phase}}: switch from {{from}} to {{to}} to allow “{{what}}”.

why.rushOut: good rushing out, useful behind a high line
why.shootLess: weak shot: look for the pass
why.directPass: can find the space in behind

cutInside.LR: left foot on the right side
cutInside.RL: right foot on the left side

why.holdPositionDm: positioning and teamwork: shields the defence

why.lateRuns: movement and shooting: good at arriving late

pi.budgetLow_one: At most {{count}} instruction per player for now: the group still lacks tactical ability for this style. More will come as it improves (see Development plan).
pi.budgetLow_other: At most {{count}} instructions per player for now: the group still lacks tactical ability for this style. More will come as it improves (see Development plan).

phaseHelp.P: 4 weeks back: P1 and P2 physical only, P3 adds ball work (Wednesday and Saturday friendlies), P4 passing, build-up, attacking and defensive work (Wednesday friendly).
phaseHelp.T: 4-week block to install the tactic, with a Wednesday match.
phaseHelp.A: First 4 months: broad technical and tactical work.
phaseHelp.B: Next 3 months: established organisation, match preparation and team bonding.
phaseHelp.C: To the end: match preparation, defensive organisation and set pieces.
phaseHelp.R: Winter break: full week of rest, as in the game. The last weeks before the restart become a mini pre-season (P1 to P4, P4 just before the restart).

train.title: Training week
train.manual: This week's matches are unknown (the game only gives the next 5): tick the match days, friendlies included.
train.metaFile: Schedule to load in the game:
train.harvestHelp: harvestgreen22's method (FM Arena, spreadsheet kept by fm-scoring): four sessions a week, one a day, Conditioning, Attacking ball work, Defensive ball work, Light conditioning, rest otherwise; the day before the match a single tactical session on your top area. It is the week that grows attributes most (33.3 CA over a season against 10.7 with no training); tactical sessions do no better than rest for attributes, they only feed tactical effectiveness.
train.teamIntensityHarvest: Setting measured by harvestgreen22: no work for players who are not in shape, double intensity for those in good and excellent shape. The game then applies it to each player; the individual focus is Quickness for every outfield player.

yield.title: What each session yields
yield.intro: CA gained over a 100-match season by an 18-year-old with only this session each week (harvestgreen22's measurement). No training: 10.7. Best measured week, four different sessions: {{best}}.
yield.help: A tactical session grows attributes no more than rest: it feeds tactical effectiveness (42.7% wins against 39.2% with eight sessions a week, at the cost of injuries). The same session three times yields less than four different sessions. The attacking and defensive variants count as the measured (balanced) ones.

train.metaHelp: AlexJeuVideal's method ("ENTRAINEMENT FM 27 META EFFICACITÉ 1.1" pack): one block Pressing Trap, Line of Engagement, Build-Up; one block Pressing Trap, Chance Creation, In-Possession Shape; the day before the match Ball Progression, Defensive Block, Conditioning. Everything else is rest. Load the .fmf file shown in the Training screen.
train.congested: three or more matches: full rest between matches (results come before development)
train.priorities: Areas of your target style worked first: {{list}}.
train.rule1: Match eve: one preparation session. Day after: Rest then Recovery. Each working day: one tactical and one development session, nothing more.
train.rule2: Rest pays off in matches: never removed for an extra session. Three-match weeks: full rest. Pressing trap: 2 sessions a week, no more. No conditioning two days before a match.
train.rule3: If a match moves, put preparation back the day before and recovery the day after.
train.rule4: Players back from international duty are handled separately.
train.rule5: Judge the plan over several weeks, not one result, and lighten it if the workload doesn't suit.
train.source: "Freedom" method (FM Scout, FM27 training schedules): 44 schedules, 4-week themed cycles. The article ships no .fmf files: FM Immersion rebuilds each day with FM27's sessions, steered by your target style. Copy it into the game's Training screen. Adjusted from AlexJeuVideal's benchmark ("The truth about tactical effectiveness"): Rest the day after every match, 2 pressing trap sessions a week, priority to build-up, chance creation, line of engagement and out-of-possession shape, full rest in three-match weeks.
train.trainingDaysHelp: A part-time club only trains on some evenings: tick the days offered in the game's Training screen. Other days without a match stay free; the last session before a match is used for preparation.
train.presetHint: Starting point in the game: load the "{{preset}}" schedule, then adjust the sessions as below.
train.weakest: Least understood areas according to the game (Effectiveness), added to the priorities: {{list}}.

reason.veryTired: condition below 80%: the game lowers the intensity
reason.tired: condition below 90%: the game adjusts the intensity
reason.young: 21 or under: team intensity, never double (freshness pays off more in matches)
reason.veteran: 32 or over: let the game manage him
reason.normal: nothing to force: the game sets it by condition

train.rusty: lacking sharpness: reserve minutes or late appearances
train.individualHelp: Matches the game's Individual Training screen. IP and OOP roles: those of his slot in the target XI, otherwise the project role he fits best. Focus: the weak point seen in matches, otherwise Quickness up to age 23, otherwise the role's weakest key attribute. Intensity: "Team" for everyone, i.e. the Team intensity setting above (double for players in good condition, half and rest for the others) that the game applies to each player according to his condition; no per-player manual setting.
train.noMentoring: No group to suggest: it needs players aged 21 or under and at least one player aged 24+ with a favourable personality (or high determination). Personality comes from the extended player read.
train.mentoringHelp: In the game: Training, Mentoring, Create Mentoring Group. The personality and determination of influential players rub off on the youngsters in the group, for better or worse. A group has at most 3 players: the mentor and 2 youngsters, from the same area of the pitch when possible.
train.setupHelp: Tick a player once their individual training is set in the game. As soon as the advice changes (condition, injury, busy week, target XI), the box unticks and the row moves to the top with the old setting struck through.
train.teamIntensityHelp: Recommended setting in Training > Team Intensity: the game then adjusts each player's intensity and rest by condition. No need to touch individual intensity, never double intensity.
train.upcomingHelp: Set ahead in the game's Training Schedule screen: one Schedule Focus and one workload per week. Light in two-match weeks, medium with one match, heavy with no match and early in pre-season. Beyond the next known fixtures, FM Immersion assumes a Saturday match.
train.reasonHint: Hover a player's intensity to see why it is advised.
train.metaAdaptHelp: AlexJeuVideal's Meta base: 2 pressing-trap sessions a week, the day before the match Ball Progression, Defensive Block, Conditioning, rest otherwise. The other 4 tactical sessions follow your priority areas (the weakest from the game and your matches) among those the benchmark finds useful: Line of Engagement, Build-Up, Chance Creation, In and Out of Possession Shape. They change when your weaknesses change.
train.coachHelp: FM Immersion programme, one proposal only: each working day, one tactical session (two Pressing Traps a week, then the areas the game rates least understood, otherwise your style's areas) and one development session (Conditioning, Attacking ball work, Defensive ball work, Light conditioning: the four sessions that raise attributes the most in harvestgreen22's measurements). Day before a match: a single match-prep session. Day after: Rest then Recovery. Never conditioning two days before a match. When the game says everything is understood, tactical sessions shrink to the two traps.
train.coachSummary: This week: {{tactical}} tactical sessions, {{grow}} development sessions, {{matches}} match(es).
train.teamIntensityCoach: Recommended in Training > Team intensity: double for players in good and excellent condition (that is what makes them progress, measured by harvestgreen22), half and rest for the others so they reach the match fresh (AlexJeuVideal's test bench). The game then applies it to each player. Individual focus: the weak point seen in matches, otherwise Quickness up to age 23, otherwise the role's weakest key attribute.

why.weak: area the game rates least understood
why.noCondition: development (no conditioning 2 days before a match)
why.indiv: no match this week: individual development
why.prep: match eve: one preparation session only
why.restDay: rest: freshness pays off in matches

coach.inGameRest: In the game: load the "{{preset}}" schedule.
coach.intensity: Team intensity: double for players in good and excellent condition, half for tired ones, nothing for exhausted ones.
coach.setups_one: {{count}} individual setting to change in the game (list below).
coach.setups_other: {{count}} individual settings to change in the game (list below).
coach.setupsOk: All individual settings are up to date in the game.
coach.yield: From {{from}} to {{to}} ({{days}} days, {{players}} players compared): {{delta}} attribute point per player, i.e. {{month}} per month; the age curve suggested {{expected}}.

yieldVerdict.good: It is progressing: keep this schedule.
yieldVerdict.flat: It is flat: normal with an ageing squad or a busy week, otherwise check the schedule is really applied in the game.
yieldVerdict.bad: It is going backwards: too many matches or rest, or an ageing squad. Compare with the declining players below.

coach.yieldSoon_one: Progress is measured over at least fourteen days of snapshots: {{count}} more game day.
coach.yieldSoon_other: Progress is measured over at least fourteen days of snapshots: {{count}} more game days.
coach.yieldHelp: Measured on your save, not on a test bench: sum of attribute points (out of 20) gained or lost by each player present at both dates, known attributes only. The baseline is the oldest snapshot of the last four weeks, at least fourteen days back. "Expected": the module's age curve (youngsters rise, over-28s decline). Good from +1.5 points per player per month, bad below −0.5.

opp.none: No report on the next opponent in this snapshot yet. The plugin reads it at every capture (« adv… » reads in chemins.json): advance a day in FM27, or wait for the automatic re-read.
opp.adviceHelp: Football advice drawn from the opposing manager's profile and key players, read from the game's team report. These are not game calculations.
opp.squadHelp: Opponent stars only show when your staff knows them.

advice.buildShort: They rarely press: build short from the back, your defenders will have time.
advice.beatPress: They press a lot: plan direct or long outlets to bypass their press.
advice.rotate: Man marking: make your players rotate and drop deep to drag their markers out of position.
advice.overloadZone: Zonal marking: overload one zone (a flank or the middle) to create numerical superiority.
advice.twoStrikers: Two strikers: keep at least three players behind the ball (a defensive midfielder, or only one full-back going forward).
advice.oneStriker: A lone striker: both full-backs can push on, two centre-backs are enough to cover him.
advice.betweenLines: Two banks of four with no attacking midfielder: put a player between their lines (attacking midfielder, false nine).
advice.counter: Attacking mentality: they will leave space behind, prepare quick counters.
advice.patience: Cautious mentality: expect a low block, move the ball and stretch the play.
advice.markCreator: {{name}} makes them tick: tight marking on him and cut his passing lanes.
advice.watchScorer: {{name}} is their goalscorer: give him no space in the box.
advice.screened: Out of possession, two defensive midfielders close the middle: attack down the flanks and behind their full-backs.
advice.leaky: Their defence concedes a clear-cut chance every {{name}} minutes: be ambitious and get bodies in the box.

opp.formsHelp: Read from the formation analysis of the game's team report. Out of possession, chances are those they concede.

memory.open: Trial: read the FM27 database directly
memory.title: Direct FM27 database reading (trial)
memory.intro: FM Immersion reads the game database in memory, from outside the game and read-only: nothing is written to FM27. Start FM27, load your save, then compare the values below with the in-game profiles.
memory.patched: Different game version: addresses found by patterns, to be checked

merc.help: Based on the imported squad, in two elevens: the one to play today ({{form}}) and the project one ({{style}} {{projectForm}}). At each position we keep the starters plus one backup per slot (two backup keepers); anyone beyond that is surplus. Stars are the staff's (current → potential, relative to the club); level is projected two seasons ahead.

kpi.incomeSub: value of players to sell · wages freed: {{wages}}
kpi.extendSub: starters and prospects within a year of expiry
kpi.offSub: profiles that don't suit the target style

merc.noYouth: No player aged 21 or under in the imported squad.
merc.youthHelp: A youngster is worth it when their profile suits the game plan and the staff rate their potential at 3 stars or more, when they catch the starter at their position within three seasons, or when they already make one of the two elevens. Blocked at 19 or older: loan them out to play. 18 or younger: they develop with the club's youth team. An off-project profile isn't worth the time, even with potential.

groupHelp.sell: No place in either eleven, not even as a backup: transfer-list them. The suggested price (game value adjusted for contract left and age) is a starting point; turn down offers below the floor.
groupHelp.release: No place in either eleven and no market value: don't renew, or terminate to free the wage.
groupHelp.loan: Promising youngsters stuck behind starters and backups: a loan gets them minutes.
groupHelp.extend: Contract ending within a year: renew before they leave on a free.
groupHelp.replace: Starters today whose profile doesn't suit the project (or outside the project eleven at 27 or older): they play while they're the best, without a renewal, until a replacement who suits the target style arrives.
groupHelp.core: starters in today's or the project eleven.

why.misfit: less suited to the target style at {{pos}}
why.potentialPa: PA {{pa}}, the starter is at {{ca}} CA

merc.stayNoYouth: Players aged 21 or under are in their own panel above.

stats.title: Data centre
stats.none: No match stats in the snapshot yet. They arrive with the plugin's next snapshot (stat* keys in chemins.json): advance one day in FM27.
stats.tooEarly: Fewer than 3 matches played: too early to judge the team.
stats.noAlert: Nothing alarming in the team's stats.
stats.help: Season stats, all competitions, as in the game's Data Centre. Each player is compared with players in his line: green = top quarter, coral = bottom quarter. Greyed out: under {{min}} minutes, not compared. "To work on" = individual training focus that targets his weakest match stat.

possession.text: Only {{value}}% pass completion: the team loses the ball too quickly for a control game.

creation.text: {{value}} xG per match: the team creates few chances.

pressing.text: {{value}}% of pressures won: the team presses without winning the ball.

duels.text: {{value}}% tackles won: the team loses its ground duels.

mistakes.text: {{value}} errors led to an opposition goal.

finishing.text: {{value}} goals versus xG: the forwards waste chances (individual focus "Chance conversion").

discipline.text: {{value}} cards per match: suspension risk, ask players to stay on their feet and tackle less hard.

stats.allNone: Full stats arrive with the plugin's next snapshot (updated chemins.json).
stats.allHelp: Current season, all competitions, as in the game's Data Centre (totals unless marked /90 or %).

legend.sort: Click a column to sort, hover it for its definition.

def.passPct: Share of attempted passes that reach a teammate.
def.progPass90: Passes that clearly move the ball towards goal, per 90 minutes.
def.keyPass90: Passes that lead directly to a shot, per 90 minutes.
def.chances90: Clear chances set up for a teammate, per 90 minutes.
def.xgPer90: Expected goals: quality of shooting chances, per 90 minutes.
def.xaPer90: Expected assists: quality of chances set up, per 90 minutes.
def.press90: Pressures that win the ball or force an error, per 90 minutes.
def.interc90: Opposition passes cut out, per 90 minutes.
def.possLost90: Possession lost, per 90 minutes (lower is better).
def.fouls90: Fouls committed, per 90 minutes (lower is better).
def.mistakes: Mistakes leading to an opposition goal (lower is better).

def.savePct: Share of shots on target saved.
def.points90: Points won per match by the team with this player on the pitch.

trend.title: Progress since {{date}}
trend.noneUp: Nobody clearly improved over the period.
trend.noneDown: Nobody clearly declined over the period.
trend.help: Recent period (stats since that date) compared with the season up to it. A player needs at least 180 minutes on each side. Threshold: 3 points for a percentage, 15% for a per-90 stat. Shows whether training and instructions pay off.
trend.wait: The comparison appears once FM Immersion has at least one in-game week of snapshots with stats (the first is from {{date}}). Keep playing with the plugin on.
trend.waitNone: No snapshots with match stats yet.

dbSearch.title: Search the whole database
dbSearch.teaser: Find signings among every player in the save, by your criteria (position, age, ability, wage).
dbSearch.help: Read-only access to the FM27 database, on demand, with the save open. CA/PA and attributes are the game's true values, not what your scouts know. Results are ranked by what they add to the project XI. Nationality and division: one or more name parts separated by commas. League level: the game's reputation (Premier League 189, LaLiga 180, Championship 136).
dbSearch.none: No player matches. Widen the criteria.

f.usefulOnly: Only those who strengthen the XI

compat.title: Best project role: {{fit}} · best role overall: {{best}}
compat.noPosition: No position of the project formation within reach
compat.help: Does the profile suit the game plan? We compare the rating in the best role of the project eleven with the best possible rating at the player's positions. Project ✓: gap of 0.3 star at most; Project ~: up to 0.8 star; Off project: more, or no position in the formation. This measures profile, not level: don't invest time (training, renewal, transfer) in an off-project player.

decide.help: Contracts ending within six months, the ones FM27 messages you about. For each: the decision to take in the game, then why (place in today's and the project eleven, fit with the game plan, age, potential).
decide.legend: Renew: starter, useful backup under 29, or promising youngster who suits the project. Renew 1 year: starter aged 31+, backup aged 29-30, or off-project starter while you find better. Sell in January: no place in either eleven or off-project profile, but has market value. Let go: same without value, or backup aged 31+.

evo.title: Development plan
evo.help: What your tactic and squad become over the next transfer windows if you follow FM Immersion: advised departures and contract expiries applied, players aged by their measured progression. The same base is kept unless another tactic is clearly better, and instructions are added as the group improves. No signing is invented: a position to recruit stays open until someone signs.
evo.perPlayerHelp: Group tactical ability {{ability}} for {{need}} wanted: the less it covers, the less we load the players.
evo.changeTip: The change falls on the window: use pre-season or the winter break to work on the new tactic before matches.
evo.recruit: Still to recruit for the project: {{list}}
evo.foot: Windows computed from the league restart month (Training settings). Provisional costs chosen by FM Immersion: changing tactic needs a half-star gain; a style too complex for the group loses up to half a star.

abilities.help: Reads your squad's real CA and PA (out of 200) from FM27's memory, read-only, once per game date. The game's stars are relative to the squad; CA/PA gives a fixed scale for progression and potential. Note: PA is a value the game hides from you.

dec.help: What FM Immersion advises, most urgent first. You remain the judge: click a card for details.
dec.none: Nothing to decide right now: keep your base tactic and today's XI.

action.letGo: Let {{names}} leave at the end of the contract
action.leavingCovered: No signing needed to replace {{leaving}} at {{pos}}: {{name}} takes over

why.potentialPa: PA {{pa}}: he can overtake the starter in his position (CA {{ca}}).
why.potential: {{stars}} ★ potential per your staff, relative to the current squad.
why.surplus: Doesn't play and has no place in the project ({{age}} years old).
why.smallGain: {{other}} would only be {{gain}} ★ better: not enough to lose tactical understanding ({{need}} ★ needed).
why.bigGain: At least {{need}} ★ better than {{other}}: worth the learning time. Switch during pre-season or the winter break.
why.weakSlot: The best player for this position only reaches {{fit}}% suitability in the project.
why.emptySlot: Nobody in the squad covers this project position.
why.blocked: Promising youngster without game time here: a loan will help him develop.
why.leaving: Flagged as leaving ({{age}}): the position is open, they no longer count in planning.
why.leavingStarter: Project starter flagged as leaving ({{age}}): the position must be filled before the next window.
why.repl_internalBetter: {{name}} takes over, has a project profile and already does better than {{leaving}}: the team improves without a signing.
why.repl_internalHolds: {{name}} takes over with a project profile, at {{leaving}}'s level: the position doesn't drop, but doesn't improve either.
why.repl_internalGrows: {{name}} is slightly below {{leaving}} but, young and with a project profile, catches up within two seasons.
why.repl_internalWeak: {{name}} would take over, but below {{leaving}}: the position would get weaker. Recruit.
why.repl_internalOff: {{name}} would take over, but their profile doesn't suit the game plan: they don't move the team towards the target style. Recruit.
why.repl_noInternal: Nobody in the squad can play this position: recruit.

unless.bigGain: Review if the gap exceeds {{need}} ★ (injuries, signings).

sheet.fewMinutes: Under 270 minutes: confirm over more matches.

foot.profileHelp: Attribute averages out of 20; dotted: the average of his line in the squad.
foot.statsHelp: Bar: where he ranks in his line, from worst (left) to best (right).

mc.backForMatch: Fit for the match (injured for {{days}} more days)

matchSheet.title: Match sheet
matchSheet.help: Planned before kick-off, without changing the base tactic. FM27: Stamina matters more late in matches and fresh substitutes have more impact; tweaks are set from the touchline.
matchSheet.noSubs: Nobody to take off in advance: decide during the match.

reason.stamina: low stamina: fades late in the match
reason.condition: below full condition before the match

tweak.keeperUp: Keeper up for the last set piece

matchSheet.followStaff: Follow the staff's advice, keep the base

live.help: During the match: set the minute and score as play goes on. FM Immersion highlights the substitutions to make and tweaks to switch on now. With plugin 0.5.0, score and minute update by themselves.
live.helpGame: Score and minute come from the game (plugin reading every 15 s, read only). FM Immersion highlights the substitutions to make and the tweaks to switch on now; tick the substitutions you made.

matchSheet.subsRule: {{count}} substitutions in {{windows}} windows; we plan fewer to keep a margin.

check.u21Xi: at least {{need}} homegrown under-21 player in the starting XI (under-21s: {{have}})
check.u21Squad: at least {{need}} homegrown under-21 player in the matchday squad (under-21s: {{have}})
check.nonEu: at most {{need}} non-EU players in the matchday squad

status.ok: met if that youngster is homegrown
status.unknown: to check (a player's nationality or homegrown status not read yet)

matchSheet.unverified: Rules taken from an FM league summary, not read from the game yet: check the competition's Rules screen.
matchSheet.friendly: Friendly: nothing at stake and free substitutions. Rotate, give minutes to youngsters and players lacking sharpness, rest key men. It counts neither in the record nor in promised playing time.

weight.cup: Cup: secondary to the league. Rotate without giving it away: keep the spine (keeper, one centre-back, the playmaker) and give minutes to those who need them.
weight.congested: Busy schedule: another match within 3 days. Rotate the worn players; fresh substitutes matter late in the match.

squadPitch.label: Squad display
squadPitch.help: Each player at their main natural position, best first. Click a name for their profile.

results.title: Results
results.none: No match found yet. It takes one squad read before a match and one after: the plugin reads every 5 minutes and FM Immersion keeps one read per game day, so the first tracked match will show after the next match played.
results.how: Nothing new is read in the game. Between two reads, FM Immersion takes the difference of the Data Hub season totals (minutes, starts, team goals while the player is on the pitch, wins, xG…): with a single match in between, it finds the exact score (the player who stayed 90 minutes saw everything), the starting eleven and each player's rating. The opponent comes from the previous read's "next match", the tactic from the following one. Several matches between two reads are grouped into one summary.

kpi.matchesSub: since FM Immersion started following the save

results.fewMatches: Not enough matches to conclude yet (at least {{min}} on each side to compare).
results.withHelp: Points per match when the player starts, then when he doesn't. A gap counts from {{min}} matches on each side (green or coral).

insight.playerMinus: With {{name}} starting ({{starts}} matches): only {{with}} pts/match, without: {{without}}. Worth a look (position, role, form).

insight.lucky: We score {{goals}} goals per match from {{xg}} xG: above the chances created, it may not last.

insight.merged_other: {{count}} periods group several matches played between two reads: those matches have no detail.

The search reads the FM27 database read-only, with the save open: players from other clubs, not injured, in the same position, with a real CA slightly below to well above his. "Follow" adds them to your targets.

why.internalHolds: {{name}} takes over with a project profile, at {{leaving}}'s level: the position doesn't drop, but doesn't improve either.
why.internalGrows: {{name}} is slightly below {{leaving}} but, young and with a project profile, catches up within two seasons.
why.internalWeak: {{name}} would take over, but below {{leaving}}: the position would get weaker. Recruit.

divLevel.title: Division level
divLevel.teaser: Each club's best XI in your league, on the project's formation, to see where your team stands and what level to aim for.
divLevel.none: No club found (unknown division or no save loaded).
divLevel.vsTop3: vs the top of the table
divLevel.help: Read-only read of the FM27 database, on demand, with the save open. For each club: its contracted players (loaned out excluded, injured left out), placed in the project's formation with the same calculation as your squad; the rating is the starters' average. CA is the average of the eleven best real CAs. For the division above, type its name (e.g. "Niké liga"): your XI is compared with their benchmarks.

diag.title: Why they underperform in their position
diag.allGood: No starter is below the team average right now.
diag.noReason: No visible cause in the data: keep an eye on the next matches (opponent, playing time).
diag.others_one: {{count}} other starter in the average but with something to watch
diag.others_other: {{count}} other starters in the average but with something to watch

reason.familiarity: Not natural in this position (familiarity {{value}}/20): he loses decisions and positioning.
reason.footL: Strong foot on the wrong side for this role on the left.
reason.footR: Strong foot on the wrong side for this role on the right.
reason.roleFit: Role rating {{fit}}, well below the rest of the eleven ({{xi}}).
reason.keyAttrs: Key attributes of the role too low: {{list}}.
reason.threshold: Demanding role: FM27 halves his rating below an ability of {{t}} (his: {{ca}}). A simpler role in the same position would suit him better.
reason.stats: In matches, in the bottom quarter of his line: {{list}}.
reason.condition: Condition at {{value}}%: he fades late in matches.
reason.sharpness: Match sharpness at {{value}}%: he lacks games.
reason.better: {{name}} would be rated higher in this slot ({{fit}}).

diag.how: Same eleven as Tactic > Line-up. The rating comes from the latest matches found in Results (otherwise the season) and is compared to the starters' average: a player is flagged 0.25 below it, or under 6.6. Causes come from what FM Immersion already reads: position familiarity, foot, role rating and key attributes (FM27 scale), threshold of demanding roles, Data Hub stats compared to his line, condition, sharpness, morale, and higher-rated subs for the same slot.

staff.title: Coaching staff
staff.teaser: Your coaches rated by area, who should handle what, and the unattached staff who would do better where we are weak.
staff.noClub: No club found for the human manager (is a save loaded?).
staff.help: Read-only access to the FM27 database, on demand, with a save open. The 1-20 attributes are the game's; an area score is a FM Immersion formula, not the game's stars: the area attribute counts three times, plus determination, authority and motivating, divided by 6. Assignments give each area to the best available coach, two areas at most each, keeping for last those who are better off the pitch (physio, scout, analyst…). Below 12 an area needs strengthening. Unattached staff can be hired without compensation.
staff.freeBetter: Unattached staff who would do better
staff.name: Name
staff.jobNote: Job: raw code read from the contract; the game's job titles still need matching (tell me the job of two or three staff members and they will show here). Each person's two best areas are highlighted.

tight.title: Money is tight: making do
tight.sellFirst_one: Sell first: {{count}} departure advised, {{income}} possible income and {{wages}} in wages freed.
tight.sellFirst_other: Sell first: {{count}} departures advised, {{income}} possible income and {{wages}} in wages freed.
tight.freeOrLoan: Sign without a fee: free agents, expiring contracts, loans (targets above the budget are tagged "over budget").
tight.youth_one: Look inside first: {{count}} youngster is worth it, and the line-up calls on the reserves or U19s whenever a position is short.
tight.youth_other: Look inside first: {{count}} youngsters are worth it, and the line-up calls on the reserves or U19s whenever a position is short.
tight.noRaise: No pay rises: extend on the same wage or not at all, the wage budget is already exceeded.

leave.help: Players you flagged as leaving. FM Immersion plans the squad without them (starters, backups, contracts, youngsters) and looks for their replacement at the same position of the project eleven: first among your followed targets and the squad, then in the game database (run straight away when you flag them). Cancel the flag if they end up staying. Players loaned to your club are listed automatically (read from the game): they go back at the end of the loan, so the transfer screen never suggests selling or extending them.
leave.sheet: Flagged as leaving: no longer part of the transfer advice. Find the replacement in Transfers › Departures and youth.

needs.title: Positions to sign ({{count}})
needs.help: The transfer shopping list, from most urgent to bench depth. Each position is judged on the project XI, without the departing players.

why.leaving: {{name}} is leaving and nobody in the squad matches their level.
why.projectGap: Nobody at the project's level in this position.
why.succession: Starter aged 31 or more: plan the succession.

needs.none: No position to fill: the squad covers the project, backups included.
needs.more: Urgent: before the next window. Project: to reach the target style. Plan ahead: depth and succession. “Search” compares your tracked targets and can run a search in the game database.

shirts.legend: Big number: the starter. Below: their backup (starter's number + 10, 30 for the goalkeeper).
shirts.noRest: Every player is a starter or a backup.
shirts.how: Starters: the best eleven in the base tactic (same style and formation as Next match > Line-up), ignoring today's form, injuries and suspensions, since a number lasts the season. Each position takes its classic number: 1 goalkeeper, 2 right back, 3 left back, 4 and 5 centre backs, 6 defensive midfielder, 8 central midfielder, 7 and 11 wide, 10 playmaker, 9 striker. Backups: the best eleven without the starters (team B), the starter's number + 10, and 30 for the goalkeeper. The others follow from 22, line by line (defence, midfield, attack), best rated first; other goalkeepers take 40, 50… Players out on loan get no number.

history.title: History kept by the plugin
history.help: The plugin keeps one file per game day. Your club's days are imported automatically (even those played while the app was closed); to resume another club's career, import them here. Days already imported are skipped.

off.title: Off-season plan
off.help: The new season is close: the summer in order, built from the decisions below. Amounts come from wages and values read in the game.
off.helpOver: The league is over: here is the summer in order, built from the decisions below. Amounts come from wages and values read in the game.
off.budget: Transfer budget: {{transfer}} · wage room after departures: {{wages}}
off.preseasonText: Pre-season schedule P1 to P4 (Training), friendlies to arrange, newcomers to settle in before the restart.

kpi.shortSub: players getting less than their status
kpi.overSub: they will ask for a better status or contract

play.help: In FM27, a player's squad status is a playing-time promise. Here his share of minutes in the matches he was available for (not injured or suspended the day before) is compared with an FM Immersion benchmark per status (star / important / regular starter / rotation / backup: {{shares}}). Alert below 80% of the benchmark. The mark on the bar shows the benchmark.
play.noMatches: No match tracked this season: snapshots are needed before and after matches.
play.adviceShort: Play him more, or lower his status in his next contract before he complains.
play.adviceOver: He plays like a {{status}}: plan a better status at his next renewal.

home.title: Home
home.heading: Welcome to FM Immersion
home.intro: Pick a mode. Each one works on its own: use only what you like.

faces.title: Photorealistic faces
faces.summary: Replaces FM27's generated faces with photorealistic portraits, and puts them back after a Steam update.

coach.title: FM Coach
coach.summary: Your career assistant: squad, tactics, training, transfers, opponent and finances, read from your save.

gazette.title: Gazette
gazette.summary: Your career's weekly newspaper: results, transfers, sackings and rumours.
gazette.details: Every in-game week, FM Immersion writes a newspaper from your save: front page, news in brief, transfers and the manager's hot seat. Past issues stay archived.

discord.title: Discord live
discord.summary: Tell your career live in a Discord channel, solo or in a shared world.
discord.details: The key moments of your save (wins, losses, transfers, injuries, league position) are posted in a Discord channel. Solo, a webhook link is enough; in a shared world, a bot also posts human-vs-human matches and the official table.

world.title: Shared world
world.summary: Asynchronous multiplayer: everyone plays their own save at their own pace, in the same world.
world.details: Each manager plays their own save. Other humans' results, transfers and job changes reach your save on the right date, with a common checkpoint every six months.

faces.intro: Generated faces (youngsters, staff, managers) switch from the game's 3D to photorealistic portraits. Then tick FM27's "Use pre-generated images of players and staff" option.

faces.step3: Restart FM27 and tick the pre-generated images option in the preferences.

editorial.title: The column
editorial.tone_crisis_0: {{count}} matches without a win, and the silence after games says it all. This is no longer a rough patch, it is a trend, and hoping will not reverse it: a reaction is needed, fast.
editorial.tone_crisis_1: You can talk about bad luck once, twice. Not {{count}} times. {{club}} must look in the mirror: the method is not working, and every week that passes makes the recovery more expensive.
editorial.tone_crisis_2: The spiral has begun. In moments like these, a dressing room looks for a culprit or a leader. At {{club}}, we are still waiting to see which one stands up.
editorial.tone_hot_0: {{count}} matches unbeaten: {{club}} are no longer playing to survive, they are playing to win, and it shows. The hardest part remains: keeping it going.
editorial.tone_hot_1: Some runs are luck, others tell the story of a team. {{club}}'s ({{count}} matches) belongs to the second kind: the plan is clear, the players believe.
editorial.tone_hot_2: Let us not spoil the moment: {{count}} matches without defeat, and a team that now knows how to suffer together. That is often where memorable seasons are born.
editorial.tone_win_0: One win does not make a season, but this one matters: {{club}} did what was needed, when it was needed. To be confirmed next match.
editorial.tone_win_1: The attitude mattered more than the score: {{club}} played to win. That is the only way to build something.
editorial.tone_win_2: Three points that lift the mood and the table. {{club}} did not get everything right, but they were there when it counted.
editorial.tone_draw_0: A point is better than nothing, but {{club}} looked like a team playing not to lose. At this rate the table will not move.
editorial.tone_draw_1: A draw and mixed feelings: we saw things, we did not see the end. {{club}} must learn to kill games.
editorial.tone_draw_2: A draw that suits nobody. {{club}} held on, {{club}} built, but lacked that little extra that makes a great week.
editorial.tone_loss_0: Defeats happen. What matters is what {{club}} make of it: a lesson, or the start of a bad habit. Answer next week.
editorial.tone_loss_1: No drama, but no excuses either: {{club}} lost to {{opponent}} because they were worse, full stop. The good news is that this can be fixed.
editorial.tone_loss_2: Losing is part of the game; losing without reacting is not. {{club}} will be judged on their response.
editorial.tone_quiet_0: A quiet week, and sometimes that is the best news: time to work, heal, prepare. Judgement comes on the pitch.
editorial.tone_quiet_1: No match, no noise. Weeks like these are for fixing what there is no time to fix otherwise.
editorial.tone_quiet_2: The calm before what comes next. At {{club}}, they are sharpening the routines.

editorial.fans_hot_1: In the terraces, they are already talking about what comes next with stars in their eyes.
editorial.fans_hot_2: The supporters have found their team again, and it shows.
editorial.fans_win_0: The stands leave with a smile.

discord.autoIntro: As soon as a game week is over, its gazette (front page image and news) is posted to your channel on its own, once a week. FM Immersion must be open while you play.
discord.autoEnable: Send my gazette automatically every week
discord.intro: Tell your career in a Discord channel: each gazette can be sent there in one click, so your friends can follow your save.
discord.step1: In Discord, open the channel settings, then Integrations › Webhooks › New Webhook.
discord.step3: Paste it below, save, then send a test message.
discord.invalid: This is not a Discord webhook link (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
discord.testMessage: FM Immersion is connected to this channel. My career gazettes will arrive here.
discord.what: For now, the weekly gazette, when you click "Send to Discord" in the Gazette. Automatic posting of key moments (goals, results, transfers) comes next.
discord.privacy: The link stays on your PC. FM Immersion sends nothing to Discord without your click, and only to Discord's webhook address.

live.title: Live match
live.intro: During your FM27 matches, one card is posted to your channel and updated every 15 seconds (scoreboard image, minute, goal timeline, commentator line), and every key moment (goal, half-time, final whistle) arrives as its own message, like a live match feed.
live.enable: Tell my matches live on Discord
live.needWebhook: First link a channel with the webhook link above.
live.plugin: Requires the FM27 plugin 0.5.0 or later, and FM Immersion open during the match. Only the score and scorers are sent.
